company.name: RST Agency Inc.
company.description1: RST Agency is a sports company that creates communities where people gather, challenge themselves, and grow through racket sports. We generate 'personal growth' beyond the pursuit of sports and contribute to the development of Japan's sports culture.
company.description2: We also plan and execute pickleball-focused events, organize official tournaments, and manage athletes. Our members, including the CEO, are competitive players themselves.
company.valueBusiness: Sports Facility Operations / Sports Events / Tournament Management / Sports Equipment Planning & Sales

founder.name: Akihiko Nishimura
founder.bio1: Born in Hokkaido. Started badminton at age 8, honing his competitive skills at Aomori Yamada High School and Chuo University, two of Japan's top badminton powerhouses. Reached the singles quarterfinals at both the Inter-High and the National High School Select Tournament.
founder.bio2: As a professional, he competed independently — without joining a corporate team — making four appearances at the All Japan Badminton Championships, the nation's premier tournament, and facing Japan's top players.
founder.bio3: In 2015, he transitioned to crossminton, recording six titles including four consecutive mixed doubles and two consecutive singles titles at the World Championships. Named World's Best Player.
founder.bio4: He discovered pickleball in 2023 and now works as both a player and tournament director. He incorporated the racket sports community "Racket Sports Tokyo" and serves as CEO of RST Agency Inc.

a1.result: Selected as JPA Japan Ranking Top Player

players.title: PBT Contract Players
players.description: THE PICKLE BANG THEORY contracts with pickleball players active both domestically and internationally, supporting them with training and practice at our facility. Through collaborative event appearances and social media outreach, we promote the growth of pickleball.
players.playerBio:
Born in Tokyo. Grew up immersed in racket sports, earning selection to the National Athletic Meet in soft tennis. Achieved world No. 1 ranking in crossminton and competed at the highest level in tournaments worldwide. Started pickleball in 2023 and rose rapidly, being selected as a first-generation member of "Pickleball X," Japan's top pro development program in 2025, and winning the final tournament.

On the court, his explosive athleticism, vocal energy, and fierce competitive spirit captivate everyone watching.

Alongside his career as a player, he actively promotes pickleball through lessons, events, and television appearances across Japan.

[ Notable Achievements ]
• Multiple domestic tournament victories
• Korean tournament champion
• Undefeated in team events in 2025
• Pickleball X Championship 2025 winner
• Pickleball Award Japan Special Player of the Year
• 2025 Prize Money Leader

services.title: SERVICES
services.lead: Three ways to train, whatever your goal — from first-timers to athletes aiming for the race.

items.description: Rent the HYROX area by the hour and train at your own pace with all the equipment. Open from 6:00 to 23:00.
A trial session for first-timers. A coach guides you through all 8 HYROX movements from scratch. Drop in empty-handed.

Small-group coached classes. Take on an authentic program with friends—covering technique and tips for each station plus race-day advice. Sessions are tailored to each participant's level, so beginners are welcome too.

whatIs.title: WHAT IS HYROX
whatIs.lead: HYROX is a fitness race: eight rounds that alternate a 1km run with one functional workout. You run 8km in total while completing eight stations — a pure test of endurance where everyone from beginners to elite athletes races to the same standard.

station01.name: SkiErg
station01.description: 1,000m powered by your upper body and core — the opening leg of the race.

station02.name: Sled Push
station02.description: Drive a loaded sled 50m. A test of pure leg and full-body power.

station03.name: Sled Pull
station03.description: Haul the sled back 50m by rope, calling on your back and grip.

station04.name: Burpee Broad Jumps
station04.description: Burpees into broad jumps for 80m — the cardio crux of the race.

station05.name: Rowing
station05.description: Row 1,000m with legs, back and arms working in sync.

station06.name: Farmers Carry
station06.description: Carry weights 200m, one in each hand — grip and core under fire.

station07.name: Sandbag Lunges
station07.description: Lunge 100m with a sandbag on your shoulders — the brutal back half.

station08.name: Wall Balls
station08.description: 100 wall-ball throws from a squat. The final test before the line.

program.title: PROGRAM
program.note: Use the training area equipped for all 8 official HYROX stations.
program.partyNote: Listed rates cover up to 4 people. Each additional person from the 5th onward is +¥1,000.

coach.name: DAISUKE SEKIYOSHI
coach.intro: A pioneer of HYROX in Japan and a current HYROX Team Japan athlete — Spartan Race's first-ever Japanese champion and a national triathlon title holder, and one of Japan's finest hybrid athletes.

items: Asia Championship 2024 — Singles Overall: 4th / Age Group: 2nd
HYROX Hong Kong 2023 — Singles Pro: first Japanese man on the podium (3rd)
2022 Age-Group Japan National Championship, Sprint — Annual Ranking: 1st

career: 22 years of service as a Chiba Prefectural Police officer
